name: Campingplatz Zellersee
beschreibung: The Zellersee campsite is located directly on the Zellersee in Zell am Ziller in the Zillertal. The Zillertaler Alpen surround the site. In summer, hiking trails are accessible directly from the site; in winter, the ski areas of the Zillertal Arena and Ski Zell. The facilities include pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. A shop and a restaurant are located on the grounds. The lake is available to guests for swimming. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and close to nature.
